# ui_theme (TASK-060D): design tokens and the shared LVGL styles, created once at start-up (07 §7).
# LVGL only - no USB, no network, no pairing logic (07 §2 dependency rule, AGENTS-UI MUST 4).
# Host tests: test/ui_components (real LVGL 9.6 sources, headless 1024x600 display).
# fonts/kvm_font_hangul_24.c: the Hangul legend subset of the KO strip (ADR-024 TECH-078), generated by
# tools/fonts/gen_hangul_font.py from Noto Sans KR; OFL-1.1, listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
# fonts/kvm_font_legend_{24,16,14}.c: the keyboard legend subset of the HOST layouts (ADR-024 TECH-078, FR-742),
# generated by tools/fonts/gen_legend_font.py from Noto Sans; each one sits behind the Montserrat of its own size
# as an LVGL fallback, so Montserrat still draws every glyph it has. OFL-1.1, listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
set(theme_srcs "src/ui_theme.c" "src/ui_font_blob.c" "src/ui_icon_star.c" "fonts/kvm_font_hangul_24.c")
set(legend_sizes 24 16 14)
set(have_legend 1)
foreach(sz ${legend_sizes})
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/fonts/kvm_font_legend_${sz}.c")
        list(APPEND theme_srcs "fonts/kvm_font_legend_${sz}.c")
    else()
        set(have_legend 0)
    endif()
endforeach()
idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${theme_srcs}
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    REQUIRES lvgl__lvgl)
target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE KVM_HAVE_FONT_HANGUL_24)
if(have_legend)
    target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE KVM_HAVE_FONT_LEGEND)
endif()
